Q.1 Read the following passage carefully and answer any five questions including Question No. 1.
The Treaty of Hudaibiyah also helped the fighting between the Polytheists and the Muslims. People began to see Islam as a religion of peace. The ten year agreement gave Muslims the chance to spread Islam freely and deal peacefully with their enemies across the Arabian Peninsula.
